bytes.description: Total bytes used by objects in the bucket.

global_alias.description: Creates a global alias for the bucket. A global alias is unique cluster-wide (e.g. `my-bucket`). You can add or remove additional aliases later using the `garage_bucket_alias` resource.

global_aliases.description: List of all global aliases currently bound to the bucket.

objects.description: Number of objects stored in the bucket.

unfinished_uploads.description: Number of unfinished uploads currently tracked for the bucket.

website_access_enabled.description: Enable static website hosting for the bucket. Defaults to `false`. When enabled, `website_config_index_document` is required.

website_config_error_document.description: Name of the error document (e.g. `404.html`). Optional, used when website hosting is enabled.

website_config_index_document.description: Name of the index document (e.g. `index.html`). Required if `website_access_enabled` is `true`.

access_key_id.description: The access key ID that this local alias is bound to.

alias.description: Local alias name. Acts as a shortcut for the bucket but only in the context of the given access key.

block.description: Creates a local alias bound to a specific access key at bucket creation time. Only one block is allowed here.

max_objects.description: Maximum number of objects allowed in this bucket. `0` means unlimited.

max_size.description: Maximum total size in bytes allowed for this bucket. `0` means unlimited.

block.description: Optional storage quotas for this bucket. If omitted or set to zero, the bucket has no limits.
This resource manages Garage buckets (global alias optional; create-time local alias optional).

access_key_id.description: Access key ID to which the local alias is bound. Required when `local_alias` is specified.

bucket_id.description: ID of the target bucket (UUID). This must be the bucket’s unique identifier, not another alias.

global_alias.description: Cluster-wide alias name. Global aliases are unique across the cluster and can be used by any access key. Conflicts with `local_alias` and `access_key_id`.

kind.description: Alias type, either `global` or `local`. Computed from the request.

local_alias.description: Local alias name. Local aliases are only valid for the access key given in `access_key_id`. Requires `access_key_id`. Conflicts with `global_alias`.

block.description: Manages a Garage bucket alias. An alias is an alternate name for a bucket, either global (cluster-wide) or local (scoped to an access key).

access_key_id.description: Access key ID that should receive the permissions.

key_name.description: Human-friendly name of the access key, if available.

owner.description: Grant owner permissions on the bucket (full administrative control).

read.description: Allow the key to read objects from the bucket.

write.description: Allow the key to write (create/update/delete) objects in the bucket.

block.description: Manage permissions granted to an access key on a Garage bucket.

access_key_id.description: Unique identifier of the access key, used in API requests and alias binding.

created.description: Timestamp (RFC3339) when the key was created.

effective_permissions.description: The effective permissions currently active for the key (read/write/admin).

expiration.description: Optional expiration timestamp in RFC3339 format (e.g. `2025-09-26T12:00:00Z`). After this time the key becomes invalid.

expired.description: True if the key is expired according to its `expiration` setting.

name.description: Human-friendly label for the access key. Does not affect permissions or behavior.

secret_access_key.description: Secret token associated with the key. Only visible at creation time — it will not be returned again.

read.description: Allow read access to buckets and objects.

block.description: Access permissions for the key. Only one block is allowed.
